text.【ケース4】Timeless Living 唯一の店舗リフォーム: [Case 4] The only commercial renovation Timeless Living has done
text.眠る楽しみを覚えたTimeless Livingの家: The Timeless Living home that taught us the pleasure of sleep
text.T様は、複数のネイルサロンなどを経営されている、お洒落で美意識の高いご夫妻。30: Mr and Mrs T run several nail salons; they dress well and have a strong sense of beauty. Mrs T has worked at the forefront of manicure for over thirty years, and her own approach to care — aimed at beautiful, healthy natural nails — and her colour technique, which draws out the quiet beauty native to Japanese hands, have won her a wide following; she is a figure of real standing in the industry. Timeless Living Shimazuyama, which they bought already renovated in April 2008, is a house with the air of a hotel: a fireplace, a bath with jets and bubbles, two basins at the washstand. Fine Scandinavian furniture, chosen by an exacting eye, sits easily in an understated and well-judged space.

text.──「Timeless Living島津山」を知ったいきさつをお聞かせください。: — How did you come to hear of Timeless Living Shimazuyama?
text.新聞の折り込み広告が手描き風でとても目を引いたんです。それで、詳細を見たら、間取: There was an insert in the newspaper, drawn in a hand-made style, and it caught the eye. We looked at the details — the plan was lovely, and it came with a garden. It looks interesting, we said; shall we call in on the way to work?
text.本当に軽い気持ちで立ち寄ったんです。新築のマンションに入ってまだ二年で、気に入っ: We really did drop in quite casually. We had only been in our new apartment two years, and it was not as though we disliked it.
text.それなのに、見て2、3日で決めてしまいました。古いマンションでこの内装、つまりチ: And yet within two or three days of seeing it we had decided. An older block with that interior — solid teak flooring and lime plaster walls — was very good indeed. In a new block I do not think we would have liked it the same way.
text.──初めてご覧になった時の印象を詳しくお話しいただけますか？: — Could you tell us in more detail how it struck you the first time?
text.それまで新築マンションばかり見ていたので、全然違うと感じました。まず、初めて来た: We had been looking at nothing but new-build apartments, so it felt entirely different. For one thing, it did not feel like somewhere I had come for the first time. And I was particularly drawn to the plaster walls.
text.素材がまったく違います。新築マンションも最近は色や柄を選べたりしますが、結局素材: The materials are completely different. New apartments let you pick colours and patterns these days, but the materials are all the same in the end, aren't they. And it is the material itself that is wrong — one simply cannot settle.
text.どれもみんな一緒に思えて。: They all seemed the same to me.
text.高額マンションのモデルルームも、お金はかかっているのかもしれないけれど、いいよね: Even the show flats in expensive developments — money has been spent, perhaps, but I could not look at them and think, yes, this is good. Mostly it was: why this wallcovering? Why this floor?
text.ピカピカで落ち着かないんです。: Everything gleams, and one cannot settle.
text.ここへ来て、古いものや、昔ながらの漆喰や無垢の木のよさが、よくわかりました。前の: Coming here taught me the merit of old things, and of traditional lime plaster and solid timber. In the old apartment, a day off spent at home made me want to go out. I could never get into the frame of mind for a long afternoon nap. Here, though, I could sleep as much as I like. At the viewing they told us one sleeps well here, and it turned out to be exactly right. I really do sleep well.
text.私も以前はしなかった“うたた寝”を、この家に来て初めてするようになりました。: I never used to doze off either; it was only after coming to this house that I started to.
text.──ホテルのような設備の使い心地はいかがでしょう？: — How do you find the hotel-like fittings in use?
text.独立型のシャワーブースから湯船への動線は、ちょっと面倒くさいところがあります。ど: Going from the separate shower enclosure to the bath is a little awkward. I am rather one for the Japanese way — a quick rinse and straight into the bath. But in return, the bath itself stays clean all the time.
text.私は全然抵抗を感じないんです。毎日必ずジェットバスに入っていますが、疲れが取れて: It does not bother me at all. I use the jet bath every single day, and it takes the tiredness out of me.
text.シャワーブースは床が「さび石」という石なんですが、使うなかでだんだん色が変わって: The shower floor is a stone called sabi-ishi, and it is interesting to see the colour change gradually with use. Materials that gain character over the years are apparently called growing stone, or growing wood — a pleasure we did not have in our old home.
text.洗面台については、ボールが2つあるタイプに憧れていたので、念願がかなって嬉しいで: I had always wanted a washstand with two basins, so I am delighted to have got my wish. There are only the two of us, but we tend to do things at the same time, so two is very convenient.
text.邪魔にされないですみます(笑)。トイレが2つあるのも便利。: Neither of us gets in the other's way (laughs). Having two WCs is convenient too.
text.トイレと洗面台を2つずつというと贅沢なようですが、毎日ストレスなく快適に過ごせる: Two WCs and two basins sounds extravagant, but it makes every day comfortable and free of friction, so I do recommend it. As for the fireplace, at first I thought we would not need it; once it was actually lit, I realised how good it is simply to watch a fire.
text.炎の暖かさは違いますね。真冬も床暖房と暖炉だけで十分。エアコンの暖房は一年中使い: The warmth of a flame is a different thing. Even in deep winter the underfloor heating and the fire are enough. We never use the air conditioning for heat, all year.
text.──家での楽しまれ方を教えてください。: — How do you enjoy being at home?
text.僕は昔からインテリアが大好きなので、折々に部屋の模様替えを楽しんでいます。夏は庭: I have always loved interiors, so I enjoy rearranging the rooms from time to time. In summer I set them so that the garden is easy to look at; in winter I turn the chairs towards the fire.
text.この住まいになって、インテリアの趣味が変わりましたね。: Living here has changed his taste in furniture.
text.以前はイタリアの家具が好きだったのですが、今は、この部屋により馴染む北欧の家具の: I used to like Italian furniture. Now I prefer Scandinavian pieces, which sit better in these rooms.
text.私は庭担当で、2年程前から本格的に手を入れ始めて、だいぶ整ってきたところです。隣: The garden is mine. I started working on it properly about two years ago and it is coming along nicely. The wall of the building next door screens it just enough, so we can leave the curtains open without being overlooked, which is good.
text.庭については、ウッドデッキテラスがリビングの床とまったく同じなので、部屋の内と外: And because the deck terrace is exactly the same as the living-room floor, inside and outside hold together, which I like.
text.庭はいろいろと手がかかりますが、少し前に植えた椿の花が咲いたら、家の中にも飾れる: A garden asks for a good deal of attention, but when the camellia we planted a while ago flowers I can bring some indoors, and the view will change — I am looking forward to it.
text.ここに来て4年が経ちますが、夫婦二人で住むには理想的な広さ、間取りだと思いますね: Four years on, I think the size and the plan are ideal for two people.
text.一人になりたいときにはなれるだけの空間があって、しかも広すぎない。あまり広いと掃: There is room enough to be alone when you want to be, and it is not too large. A very large place is hard work to clean.
text.この家のよさは実際に来てもらうとすぐにわかるんですけどね。Timeless Li: You understand what is good about this house the moment you come in. I keep telling Timeless Living they are welcome to use ours as a show flat (laughs).
text.明るく快活なご主人様と聡明で美しい奥様。日々、忙しくお仕事をされているお二人とっ: A bright, lively husband and a clever, beautiful wife. For two people whose working days are busy, what matters most in a home is being able to relax. Their house reflects that, and it is both comfortable and full of a keen sense of beauty. We expect both the interior and the garden to go on getting better.
